hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that runs a per-pool buyback pot: on sells of the designated main token, beforeSwap absorbs the sell at the pool's own execution price (SHIELD, using a BeforeSwapDelta), preventing price impact; on buys, afterSwap executes a sandwitch-resistant buyback pump and delivers acquired tokens to a recipient (default: burn). Supports optional LP programs with auto-compounding concentrated-liquidity fee harvesting.
